objective: Build a newly signed installable BUKLOD staging-user APK from the exact current released production main app source, never from older diverged staging branches or stopped V30 AAB branch. Build only: do not publish any OTA/web/Play changes.
productionBaselineEvidence: 2026-11-08 latest production merge d67e805879e3398cbff8a4383c6c7e05039ed9f7 from PR #581; Android OTA update 01a1bb25-6d17-7d36-a5ad-85740ee22493 successfully verified runtime 1.3.2; Expo Hosting live at buklod.expo.app. Previously used staging-user branches had stale/diverged source; do not reuse. Stopped production V30 AAB PR #582 remains separate, not merged.
chosenApproach: Create one isolated source-locked new GitHub Actions workflow using the existing EAS staging-user profile (internal apk, preview env, staging-user channel), derive staging-native identity from production app.config.js without changing source. Merge only after scope and regression CI. Explicit main release marker launches exactly one EAS --wait cloud APK build and verifies status FINISHED, app version, source SHA and .apk URL. No OTA or production web release.
selectionRationale: A new build from main provides all latest cumulative Wall/Points/Connect/Scope features while avoiding divergence. Staging-user package org.mzbministry.buklod.staging and Firebase credentials isolate native installation; Expo runtime remains 1.3.2 and standalone profile staging-user is used instead of production or gradle debug APK. EAS channel is staging-user; no publishing.
alternativeApproaches: Re-run prior staging branch: rejected because it can be behind main and produce the old screens/runtime.
Use production or staging-dev APK profile: rejected because package/channel/env differ or could alter other clients.
Publish staging OTA: rejected; user only asked to build the installable staging-user APK.
Build using prior Gradle debug path: rejected because no signed EAS installable staging-user artifact with source provenance and existing EAS profile.
preserveBehaviors: The exact production source, binaries, OTA updates, Expo web, Google Play, database and user's pending V30 branch are untouched.
BUKLOD main production package remains org.mzbministry.buklod, versionName 1.3.5, versionCode 29; only staging config is selected by environment.
Staging package org.mzbministry.buklod.staging; native runtime 1.3.2, staging Firebase, preview environment and staging-user update channel retained.
No use of outdated staging branch and no automatic release to production.
acceptanceChecks: No application source files, app.config.js, eas.json, dependencies, android/ios or database changes; only one new workflow, one test and this scope manifest.
Protected workflow only fires on explicit authorized main merge marker and validates current live main source ancestry and SHA.
Build must report FINISHED with Android platform, .apk signed cloud EAS URL, version 1.3.4 and source SHA matching merge.
No production OTA, staging OTA, web deployment or Google Play submission.
